T170.evidence: Measured with the load harness (tests/performance: `pnpm perf:seed` / `perf:stack` / `perf:run`) at full §28.3 volume on the 4-CPU development container, not the staging hardware. The setup was three web processes behind Caddy plus the worker, with the access cache, the analytics read model and the list indexes. In the steady state (30 reads/s + 5 writes/s) all 6 threshold classes are met (p95: list 186 ms, detail 127 ms, search 295 ms, analytics 79 ms from the warmed read model, writes 280 ms, heavy 161 ms). The ×3 burst needs about 6.4 cores and saturates the 4-CPU host, so over all measured phases 0 of 6 classes are met (p95 7–12 s). Queue lag stayed within 2.3 s in the steady state. Report: docs/acceptance/performance-report.md, with earlier runs next to it. Re-run on staging before sign-off.
